entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Beings created from a god's mind in Nyx, fragments of divinity or incarnate dreams.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr planeswalker whose rituals to propel himself to godhood caused Nyxborn to appear in the mortal world.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Starry domain of the gods on Theros.

events.summary: Nyxborn began appearing in the mortal world after Xenagos performed rituals to become a god.
events.quote: after the Satyr Planeswalker Xenagos began a series of mystical rituals to propel himself to godhood
